analysis_window.reason: Forecast features require eight prior player-gameweeks.

rules.squad: 2 GK, 5 DEF, 5 MID, 3 FWD; maximum 3 players per club
rules.lineup: predicted legal XI and predicted captain; score uses an explicit start-probability and conditional-points model; no automatic substitutions or chips
rules.transfers: one free transfer per gameweek; unused transfers bank up to five; additional transfers cost 4 points
rules.pricing: price at acquisition; incoming players use their current price; FPL selling-price effects are not modeled
rules.horizon: Fixture-hybrid transfer decisions use the current plus next 3 gameweeks, with weights [1.0, 0.8, 0.6, 0.4] and deadline-frozen player/team inputs.
